scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:web && cd apps/mobile && cap sync
scripts.android: npm run build:mobile && cd apps/mobile && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run build:mobile && cd apps/mobile && cap open ios
scripts.build:artifact: npm run build:single && python3 tools/to-artifact.py dist-single/index.html dist-single/overboom.html
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings packages/core/test/arena.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings packages/core/test/sim.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings packages/net/test/net.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings packages/audio/test/audio.test.ts && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings packages/data/test/i18n.test.ts
